component.name: Anchoa
component.summary: Keyboard-first file manager with a command panel

description.p: Anchoa is a file manager for the Linux desktop, built with GTK 4 and libadwaita, with a command panel for batch and conditional file operations such as moving every photo older than 30 days into an archive folder.

ul.li: Every command is previewed and confirmed before it runs, and can be undone
Deleting means moving to the trash
Works fully offline; no file contents ever leave the computer
